text: Writes tests, fixes lint errors, resolves merge conflicts, updates dependencies, and writes release notes
quote: Claude Code handles the tedious tasks that eat up your day: writing tests for untested code, fixing lint errors across a project, resolving merge conflicts, updating dependencies, and writing release notes.

text: Takes a plain-language description, plans the approach, and writes code across multiple files, then verifies it works
quote: Describe what you want in plain language. Claude Code plans the approach, writes the code across multiple files, and verifies it works.

text: Works directly with git: stages changes, writes commit messages, creates branches, and opens pull requests
quote: Claude Code works directly with git. It stages changes, writes commit messages, creates branches, and opens pull requests.

text: Via MCP, can read design docs in Google Drive, update Jira tickets, pull data from Slack, or use custom tooling
quote: With MCP, Claude Code can read your design docs in Google Drive, update tickets in Jira, pull data from Slack, or use your own custom tooling.

text: Reads a CLAUDE.md project file at session start to apply coding standards, architecture decisions, and review checklists
quote: CLAUDE.md is a markdown file you add to your project root that Claude Code reads at the start of every session. Use it to set coding standards, architecture decisions, preferred libraries, and review checklists.

text: Can spawn multiple agents to work on different parts of a task at once, with a lead agent coordinating and merging results
quote: Spawn multiple Claude Code agents that work on different parts of a task simultaneously. A lead agent coordinates the work, assigns subtasks, and merges results.

text: Composable Unix-style CLI: logs can be piped in, run in CI, or chained with other tools
quote: Claude Code is composable and follows the Unix philosophy. Pipe logs into it, run it in CI, or chain it with other tools

text: Can run on a schedule to automate recurring work like PR reviews, CI failure analysis, dependency audits, and doc syncing
quote: Run Claude on a schedule to automate work that repeats: morning PR reviews, overnight CI failure analysis, weekly dependency audits, or syncing docs after PRs merge.

text: Remote Control lets you keep working on tasks from your phone or any browser
quote: Step away from your desk and keep working from your phone or any browser with Remote Control

text: Can start a long-running task on the web or mobile app, then pull it into your terminal with a teleport command
quote: Kick off a long-running task on the web or the Claude mobile app, then pull it into your terminal with `claude --teleport`.

text: Can be triggered from Slack by mentioning @Claude with a bug report to get back a pull request
quote: Route tasks from team chat: mention @Claude in Slack with a bug report and get a pull request back

text: Provides automatic code review on every GitHub pull request
quote: Get automatic code review on every PR | GitHub Code Review

text: Desktop app lets you review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side
quote: Review diffs visually, run multiple sessions side by side, schedule recurring tasks, and kick off cloud sessions.

text: Can run long tasks in the cloud with no local setup, work on repos not checked out locally, and run multiple tasks in parallel
quote: Run Claude Code in your browser with no local setup. Kick off long-running tasks and check back when they're done, work on repos you don't have locally, or run multiple tasks in parallel.

text: Maps and explains entire codebases in seconds using agentic search, without manual context file selection
quote: Claude Code maps and explains entire codebases in a few seconds. It uses agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without you having to manually select context files.

text: Integrates with GitHub, GitLab, and CLI tools to handle a full workflow: reading issues, writing code, running tests, and submitting PRs
quote: Claude Code integrates with GitHub, GitLab, and your command line tools to handle the entire workflow—reading issues, writing code, running tests, and submitting PRs—all from your terminal.

text: Can debug live running web applications via a Chrome integration
quote: Debug live web applications | Chrome

text: Agent SDK lets developers build their own agents using Claude Code's tools, with control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions
quote: the Agent SDK lets you build your own agents powered by Claude Code's tools and capabilities, with full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions.

text: JetBrains plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm and others with interactive diff viewing and selection context sharing
quote: A plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other JetBrains IDEs with interactive diff viewing and selection context sharing.

text: VS Code extension provides inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and conversation history in the editor
quote: The VS Code extension provides inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and conversation history directly in your editor.

text: Can update an email template based on new Figma designs posted in Slack, combining design and chat tool context
quote: Update our standard email template based on the new Figma designs that were posted in Slack

text: Can query a PostgreSQL database to find user emails matching a feature usage criterion
quote: Find emails of 10 random users who used feature ENG-4521, based on our PostgreSQL database.

text: Kick off long-running tasks and check back later, work on repos not local, or run multiple tasks in parallel
quote: Kick off long-running tasks and check back when they're done, work on repos you don't have locally, or run multiple tasks in parallel.
